subject: Internal data pipelines vs 3rd party annotation
text:
Hi Khizar,

We’ve been working with Invisible AI's team to solve similar challenges to
those I'd imagine faced at Retrocausal i.e. ensuring annotation accuracy
and streamlining distributed labelling across internal and external teams.

They’ve seen big gains by verifying annotations faster, tracking
consistency across annotators, and comparing new datasets to past model
outputs... all without exposing customer data to third parties.

Given how much of Retrocausal’s data comes from customers, I thought it
might be worth sharing how they built secure, internal pipelines while
improving model iteration speed using Encord’s video-native annotation
tool, rather than frame-based tools like CVAT.

Would you be open to a short intro call next week to learn more? Afternoons
